title: Biology (B.S.)
summary: An undergraduate map of the science of life, from atoms to the biosphere.

layers.basics: Biology asks how living things work, how they came to be, and how they interact. This track walks from chemistry through cells, genes, evolution, organisms and ecosystems.
layers.deeper: The degree is organised in levels: molecules, cells, organisms, populations, ecosystems. Each level has its own laws, but evolution and energy flow tie them together.
layers.expert: Modern biology is quantitative and comparative: statistics, modelling and sequencing now sit beside microscopy and physiology as core skills. Claims are graded by certainty so open questions stay visibly open.
